correctness.rationale: For all n>=0, Legendre factorial valuations reduce exactly to (s_3(2u-1)-1)/2 with u=(n+1)/3^{v3(n+1)}; the endpoint and every primitive u<3^L form an exhaustive disjoint partition for n<3^m. A two-carry digit transfer with initial (x,1), transition [[1+x^2,x],[x,1+x^2]] and terminal (1,x)^T yields the exact second-order polynomial recurrence A_{L+2}=2(1+q)A_{L+1}-(1+q+q^2)A_L, A_1=2,A_2=3+3q. Summation gives the rational bivariate identity. For fixed j, coefficient extraction at the unique pole z=1 of order 2j+3 with leading coefficient 1 gives m^{2j+2}/(2j+2)!; the endpoint maxima follow from leading terms of A_L. The actual standard-library verifier independently checks factorial/digit valuations through n=6560, exact integer Raney valuation through n=219, full polynomial histogram through m=8, and rational identity through m=12. These computations are corroboration only.

value.rationale: The complete valuation frequencies are a natural strengthening of prime-zero support for the established R_{3,2} sequence. The rational generating function simultaneously resolves exact counts for all ternary scales and all fixed prime-power moduli and supplies the nontrivial quantitative laws count~m^{2r}/(2r)! and maximal-valuation multiplicity m+1. It is a structural enumeration of an infinite natural invariant, not a mere recoding of a known small table or isolated numerical check.
